themes.name: Space, Quantum and Cyber: Government Funded Frontier Tech
themes.what: Small space and quantum names rose on contracts in a falling week. AST SpaceMobile will build its own reusable rocket with Firefly's Miranda and Vira engines: $250 million for engines for the first three launches, $250 million over three years for engineering, and a license to make the engines, with launches from late 2028 (SEC 8-K; StockTitan's 'over $1.3 billion' total was not confirmed). IonQ's Q3 revenue rose 336% to $173.8 million and it raised its 2026 guide to $505 million to $515 million (SEC 8-K). On Nov 6 FLY rose 36.80%, IONQ 23.42% and KRMN 42.13% (Massive).
themes.for_you: No action. None has a buy verdict and one day jumps of 20% to 40% often fade. RKLB reports Monday Nov 9 and is rated Avoid. Left ASTS out of both lists: building a rocket adds cost and years of risk.

innovations.name: Technology
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Qualcomm's fiscal Q4 (Nov 4): revenue $10.32 billion, down 8%; handset chips $5.14 billion, down 26%; automotive $1.99 billion, up 89%; IoT up 4%. It guided fiscal Q1 2027 to $10.4 billion to $11.2 billion and repeated a $5 billion data center revenue target for fiscal 2027 (SEC 8-K). The stage does not change: phone weakness offsets car and data center growth.
innovations.for_you: No action. QCOM (165.41 on Nov 6, Massive) has no buy verdict. Left out of both lists: falling handset sales and fast car growth pull in opposite directions.

countries.name: European Union
countries.what: US brokered Russia and Ukraine talks resume in Abu Dhabi on Nov 10 and 11, the first round since February, with envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner (Latin Times, Nov 3; Whalesbook, Nov 6). A peace path would lower Europe's energy risk; Zelensky warned of a possible large Russian strike on energy and logistics before the talks.
countries.for_you: No action. Left out of both lists: real progress would help European buyers of energy and hurt energy producers like TTE, while a failed round changes nothing. VGK closed 87.31 on Nov 6 (Massive).

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Brent's January contract settled at $98.32 on Nov 6, about 13% lower for the week, and WTI at $90.83 (FinanceFeeds, Gulf News). A crew member died in an explosion on the empty tanker MT Velos Sapphire headed to Bahrain; the operator suspects a missile (Gulf News, Nov 7). Flows through Hormuz are below 60% of capacity (FinanceFeeds). XLE fell 12.00% for the week (Massive).
countries.for_you: No oil swings or energy puts; energy stocks fell harder than oil this week. Cheaper fuel helped DAL rise 8.80% to 87.20 (Massive), but DAL has no new verdict on Nov 5 data. A failed deal would bring the oil premium back quickly.
